user_query: What does Figure 4 in the paper "Attention is All You Need" discuss?
final_answer: Figure 4 in the paper "Attention is All You Need" discusses two attention heads in layer 5 of 6 that are involved in anaphora resolution. The top part shows the full attentions for head 5, while the bottom part isolates attentions from the word ‘its’ for attention heads 5 and 6. It is noted that the attentions for this word are very sharp (Source: attention-is-all-you-need.pdf, Page: 14).
